svg.aria-label: The six metadata questions applied to the cell tower layer
svg.title: The six metadata questions, applied to the cell tower data

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Reading the tower layer's metadata: the six questions from CCE 114

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every answer below comes from the source layer's description and READ-ME-FIRST.txt in the extract. Check them yourself.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WHAT

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: What do the data represent?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Point locations of FCC cellular license sites:

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: one record per licensee per site, not one per

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tower. Fields include Licensee, StrucType and

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: AllStruc (height, m). 33 of the 224 Utah records

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: share their exact spot with another record.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WHERE

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Where, and in what coordinate system?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The extract is every Utah record.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stored in latitude/longitude (GCS WGS 1984),

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: so it must be projected before you measure

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a distance or a density in kilometers.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WHEN

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: When were the data collected?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Source layer: 'Last Data Update: 07/06/2024'.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It is an ARCHIVE: its publisher says it will

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: no longer be updated or maintained.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every tower built since is missing.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WHY

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Why were they created?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HIFLD gathers infrastructure layers for

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: homeland security and emergency management,

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: here compiled from the FCC's licensing records.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Not to measure coverage, and not for your question.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: How were they collected and processed?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Licensees report sites to the FCC for the

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cellular Radiotelephone Service (the original

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 800 MHz band) only. Sites licensed only for PCS,

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: AWS or later spectrum are not in it at all.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WHO

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Who maintains them, and may you use them?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Federal Communications Commission, via the

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HIFLD program; hosted by Federal_User_Community.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: U.S. government data, no use restrictions.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Credit the FCC and HIFLD in your report.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The question that matters most here is HOW: this layer is a small, dated subset of the towers that exist.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A 'low tower density' cell may only mean 'no FCC cellular license site recorded nearby'. Your report has to say so.
